hypotheses.S1_tangent_rank_survives: At 10% coordinate removal, median final-state rank90 is at least as large as median local-write rank90.
hypotheses.S2_final_rank_scale_stability: Median final-state rank90 changes by no more than 20% between 10% and 100% removal.
hypotheses.S3_direction_scale_stability: Median per-site cosine between 10% and 100% final-state effects is at least 0.70.
hypotheses.S4_local_kl_scaling: The fitted log-log slope of median KL versus removal scale lies between 1.5 and 2.5.
